annotations.title: Build the link page from the person's profiles

description: Build the bio page in one go from the person's connected accounts and their own pages, through official APIs only (never Instagram or TikTok web pages). Name, photo and bio each come from the first account, in connection order, that has one, then from the link page found; the name falls back to the workspace's. Every account becomes an icon. A link page a profile points to (Linktree, Beacons, Stan…) brings its links, sections, icons and colors; the person's own site becomes a link with its page's name and picture; addresses in a bio or channel description become links, with a code beside one ("code BREAD10"). Links in recent captions and YouTube descriptions come back as suggestions only: add the ones the person picks with links_add. Shop the post turns on when posts are published; attach lists posts to give products with post_links_set. Only empty parts are filled and a new page stays offline. filled_from says where each part came from. Try dry_run first; undo with activity_id takes off all it added.

colors.description: Copy the link page's colors and button shape, on a page that still has its first look

dry_run.description: Say what would be built, changing nothing

from.description: Also build from these (with nothing connected, only from these): a link page like linktr.ee/name, the person's own site, or a social profile. Profiles we're not connected to aren't read; they become icons

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
